tests.title: ports ff_get_pcm_codec_id for big-endian integer PCM with per-width sign masks
parses the 128-byte AVR header with bounded reads and serves PCM packets from offset 128
refuses AVR headers in native order with native exit statuses and unported layouts explicitly
aborts AVR opens and packet reads on the signal
registers a demux-only avr descriptor detected by the 2BIT magic
matches native AVR stream copy framecrc and s16le decode for sign masks widths channels rates and odd lengths
matches native AVR WAV decode and seek duration selections with and without -f avr
refuses AVR chan, rate, unmapped bps, unported bps and partial trailing frames before any output

details: 288 byte-exact: 96 test-built AVR files (bps 8/16/24/32 x sign 0/0xffff/width sign bit/all-but-sign-bit x mono/stereo x 8000/22050/96000 Hz, odd frame counts 1023/2207/9601) compared for -c:a copy -bitexact -f framecrc autodetected and with -f avr, and -cpuflags 0 -f s16le decode; native framecrc header checked to show the AVR stream before autodetection parity is claimed (96/96 did)
72 byte-exact: 4 files x {autodetected, -f avr} x (-bitexact WAV decode + 8 framecrc profiles: input -ss, output -ss/-t, input -ss with -t, -frames:a 2; copy and pcm_s16le)
12 exit-status: chan 2, rate 0, bps 0/40/65/unsigned 64, autodetected and -f avr; Edge exit status equals native 176 (PATCHWELCOME) or 183 (INVALIDDATA), no output created
plus 4 native-acceptance checks for inputs Edge refuses (bps 12, bps 4, signed bps 64, partial trailing frame)

unsupported: bps not a multiple of 8 (native accepts, e.g. 12 as s16be with block_align 1)
bps 64 signed (native pcm_s64be; not in PcmCodec)
partial trailing sample frame (native emits a short final packet)
Workers runtime and macOS arm64 oracle not verified

proposedContracts.name: matches native AVR stream copy framecrc and s16le decode for sign masks widths channels rates and odd lengths
proposedContracts.scope: AVR 2BIT demux: integer PCM 8/16/24/32-bit, sign masks, mono/stereo, three rates; copy framecrc (autodetected and -f avr) and s16le decode.

proposedContracts.name: matches native AVR WAV decode and seek duration selections with and without -f avr
proposedContracts.scope: AVR WAV decode and -ss/-t/-frames:a framecrc selections, copy and pcm_s16le, four layouts.

proposedContracts.name: refuses AVR chan, rate, unmapped bps, unported bps and partial trailing frames before any output
proposedContracts.scope: AVR chan/rate/unmapped-bps refusals with native exit statuses 176/183; explicit refusal of native-accepted unported bps and partial trailing frames before output.

proposedContracts.name: refuses AVR headers in native order with native exit statuses and unported layouts explicitly
proposedContracts.scope: AVR header refusal order, classes and native exit statuses.

notes: Spec listed bps=12 among refusals with native exit status, but native FFmpeg 9.0.2 exits 0 for bps 12 (maps to pcm_s16be with block_align 1). The port refuses it explicitly with AvrError (exit 1); the differential test asserts native accepts it.

Native avr_probe returns 25 (AVPROBE_SCORE_EXTENSION/2) for every valid file, mono and stereo alike; Edge detects 2BIT at precedence 100. All 96 differential files were autodetected as AVR by native too; other payloads could be misdetected natively.
No index.ts export was needed; tests import the module by path.
Setup durations: submodule init 41 s, npm ci 9 s, reference:build 176 s, baseline checks 57 s, baseline unit suite 87 s.
